rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a fold line or crease in clothing or another flexible material.

example.english: There is a crease in the sleeve cuff of this shirt.
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 zau6 hau2 jau5 tiu4 zaap3

rows.note: Use this in cricket when referring to one of the marked lines on the pitch.

example.english: The cricket player stepped over the crease, so the umpire stopped play.
example.traditional: 板球員企過咗界線，俾裁判吹停。
example.jyutping: baan2 kau4 jyun4 kei5 gwo3 zo2 gaai3 sin3 bei2 coi4 pun3 ceoi1 ting4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the restricted area or circle around a goal in the relevant sport.

example.english: In handball, attacking players cannot step into the crease.
example.traditional: 手球比賽入面，進攻球員唔可以踏入龍門區。
example.jyutping: sau2 kau4 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 zeon3 gung1 kau4 jyun4 m4 ho2 ji5 daap6 jap6 lung4 mun4 keoi1
